title: The Gauntlet
description: A level 1-to-20 encounter ladder for Pathfinder 2e Remastered: fight, level up, fight the next rung, with party-size and difficulty scaling plus environmental effects.

recommends.reason: Plays the JB2A effects for strikes, auras, terrain and hazards. Without it the board still draws every footprint as a coloured shape and the gauntlet runs unchanged.
The free animation library. Every cue this module ships names a path it holds, so a free table sees every strike, aura and hazard animate. Named for 5e; the assets are system-agnostic.

The Patreon library, roughly six times the assets under the same 'jb2a' namespace. Where it is present a cue takes its richer asset, so a fire strike burns and a cold one rimes. Install it through the JB2A Patreon; enabling it beside the free module is supported and JB2A merges the two.
